scope: Find an independently useful first GPR module with large, multi-dataset development gains; preserve all failed probes. No claim of universal improvement.
capacity_reference: first eligible measured capacity in the chronological support
source_cell_selection: If over 60 train cells, deterministic round-robin across dataset/domain groups, selecting equally spaced natural-order cells within each group; before inspecting labels or errors.
source_sample_selection: Same as champion: balanced per-cell quota, include first K, uniformly spaced remaining eligible cycles. Exact source keys shared by all candidates.
inner_validation: Last naturally numbered cell of each non-heldout domain; all other non-heldout cells eligible for source selection.
folds: XJTU: six original conditions; MATR: leave one batch out; Tongji: leave one recorded chemistry-temperature-charge/discharge protocol group out. Additional leave-one-development-dataset folds are separately named.
rank_metric: Per-cell MAE then equal domain weights within each dataset; report each dataset, RMSE, P95 AE, low-SOH and per-cell changes separately.
search: Per candidate specify hyperparameter list before its run. Inner validation chooses configuration, never outer development-target query labels. Architecture search uses explicitly declared development results and must be confirmed after freezing.

permissions.source: Only the same 1000 or fewer labeled source sample keys; source support signals within first K allowed.
permissions.target: First K signals and labels, current query signal only; no future lifecycle, no future query labels in fitting.
permissions.history: Previous historical benchmark access must be disclosed; these files do not restore virgin test status.

notes: For XJTU the cell cap is inactive; source keys and original GPR predictions must reproduce the champion exactly.
The 60-cell source cap allows all first-K labels and later-life source labels within 1000 samples for larger datasets. All eligible cells are still evaluated in their respective outer folds.
Ordinary feature processing, kernel changes, posterior adaptation and label-budget changes cannot be presented as original module contributions.
10-15% mean MAE reduction is a research target, not a result; all-dataset improvement requires actual paired evidence on every declared dataset.
